mechanism: Eslicarbazepine is an inducer of CYP3A4 and CYP2D6, which may increase metabolism of methylphenidate, potentially reducing its efficacy; additive CNS stimulation and seizure threshold effects require monitoring.
action: Monitor methylphenidate efficacy during concurrent use; consider dosage adjustment if seizure control or ADHD symptoms are suboptimal; ensure adequate seizure prophylaxis maintained.
